**Synopsis:**
US 30-year Treasury yields hit their highest since 2007 (5.3371%) amid Middle East conflict escalation driving oil prices and inflation fears. Equities sold off (Nasdaq -1.33%, S&P 500 -0.69%). Japanese JGB yields near 3% — a 30-year high — raise structural concerns about capital rotation out of US Treasuries into Japanese bonds, adding upward yield pressure. Fed rate hike probability stands at 35% for September, 69% by December. Markets await FOMC minutes and Jackson Hole for policy signals. Dollar modestly stronger; gold fell sharply.
